issues.description: conandata.yml manually adds 6 mirror/proxy URLs (gh-proxy.com, mirror.ghproxy.com, ghproxy.com, gitclone.com, moeyy.cn, kkgithub.com) before the official GitHub URL. Rule R39 states: 'CI 会自动为 GitHub URL 添加镜像 fallback（gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub），因此 conandata.yml 中只需写官方原始 URL，不要手动加镜像前缀。' The conandata.yml should only contain the official URL; CI will add mirror fallbacks automatically.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove all 6 mirror URLs, keep only the official URL as a single string: url: "https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/releases/download/v1.21.1/cargo-binstall-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.full.tgz". CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks.

issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is explicitly forbidden by code style rule 5 ('禁止残留模板占位符'). The rule lists this exact pattern as indicating incomplete work ('未完成').
issues.fix_suggestion: Fill in the recipe URL (Conan recipe repository URL, e.g., the cnb.cool repository URL) or remove the url attribute if not applicable for this project.

issues.description: Shell script uses 'set -eu' but is missing '-o pipefail'. Code style rule 7 requires 'set -euo pipefail'. The script contains pipes (e.g., line 30: 'cargo-binstall --help 2>&1 | head -5') where pipefail is needed to catch failures in the first command of a pipeline.

Non-standard output format markers. Script uses '[test]' instead of '[step]', 'OK:' instead of '[ok]' with 8-space indent, 'FAIL:' instead of '[fail]'. Code style rule 9 requires standard markers: [step] for steps, [ok]/[fail] for results with 8-space indent alignment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace '[test]' with '[step]', 'echo "OK: ..."' with 'echo "        [ok] ..."', 'echo "FAIL: ..."' with 'echo "        [fail] ..."' throughout the script.

issues.description: '|| true' used without explicit comment explaining why error is suppressed. Code style rule 10 states: '禁止 || true 吞掉错误（除非有明确注释说明为何忽略）'. The command 'WASI=$(detect-wasi 2>&1) || true' suppresses the exit code of detect-wasi without explanation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an inline comment: 'WASI=$(detect-wasi 2>&1) || true  # detect-wasi returns non-zero when WASI is not runnable; expected behavior, capture output regardless'

issues.description: '|| true' used without explicit comment. The command 'HELP=$(cargo-binstall --help 2>&1 | head -5) || true' suppresses errors without explanation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add an inline comment: 'HELP=$(cargo-binstall --help 2>&1 | head -5) || true  # --help may return non-zero on some platforms; capture output for inspection'

issues.description: Status inconsistency: manifest.yaml declares 'status: published' (meaning CI upload succeeded) but notes.md footer (line 81) says '最终状态: built' (meaning verified, not uploaded). These two statements directly contradict each other. The review_memory rule states 'manifest.yaml 状态必须真实：published=CI upload 成功，built=验证通过未 upload'. If the package was only built and verified locally (W3 Local CI Simulation per test-report.md) without actual upload to a remote repository, then 'published' would not be truthful. However, notes.md header also says '状态: published', making the situation internally inconsistent within notes.md itself.
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify the actual upload status. If the package has NOT been uploaded to the remote Conan repository, change manifest.yaml status to 'built'. If it HAS been uploaded, update notes.md footer from 'built' to 'published' for consistency. The discrepancy must be resolved before merge.

issues.description: The patch_generation section declares 'patches_count: 2' and patch_classification lists '0001-cargo-binstall.patch' and '0002-detect-targets.patch'. However, these patch files do not exist — the patches/ directory only contains .gitkeep (empty), and conandata.yml has 'patches: {}'. The conanfile.py calls apply_conandata_patches() but no patches are declared. This metadata is misleading as it references non-existent patch files.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove or correct the patch_generation and patch_classification sections to reflect reality: patches_count: 0, empty patch_classification list, or remove these sections entirely since this is a precompiled binary package with no patches.

issues.description: The file 'conan-create.log' is a '*.log' file, which is explicitly listed as a prohibited file type in PRs per review_memory rule 19: 'PR 中禁止的文件：.build-context-*、test-report、*.log、.DS_Store、__pycache__/、预编译二进制（.o/.so/.a）'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove conan-create.log from the PR. If the build log is needed for reference, convert it to a .md report format (e.g., conan-create-report.md with the log content in a code block) or add it to .gitignore.

issues.description: Shebang uses platform-specific path '#!/data/service/hnp/bin/bash' instead of the standard '#!/usr/bin/zsh' recommended by code style rule 6. This is acceptable for HarmonyOS-specific scripts where bash is at a non-standard path, but noted for awareness.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using '#!/usr/bin/env bash' for better portability across environments, or keep as-is if the script is only intended to run on HarmonyOS.

summary: Audit of cargo-binstall 1.21.1 Conan recipe: PASS (no P0 or P1 issues found). The recipe correctly uses precompiled aarch64-unknown-linux-musl static binaries from the official GitHub releases of cargo-bins/cargo-binstall, with proper ELF adhoc self-signing via binary-sign-tool for HarmonyOS execution. R34 (empty shell test) check PASSED: test.sh genuinely executes all three binaries (cargo-binstall -V, detect-targets, detect-wasi, cargo-binstall --help) and verifies their outputs with grep/case assertions — not an empty shell test. SHA256 is real (64 hex characters, not placeholder). URLs point to official GitHub releases. R32 (OHOS platform compatibility) PASSED: validate() correctly checks self.settings.os in ('Linux', 'OHOS'). R33 (no hardcoded shell env vars) PASSED: no os.environ assignments in the main conanfile.py; test_package uses os.environ.get() with fallback default. R9 (skip test/fake pass) PASSED: no 'def test(self): pass', no os.system('exit 0'), no commented-out test calls. R19 (manual packaging bypass) PASSED: no precompiled .so/.a/binary files committed in PR. Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.files). commands.json format correct (type='tool', binary=true, name matches package). package_info() correctly sets bindirs=['bin'] with empty libs for an application. 10 issues found (all P2/P3, no P0/P1): (1) conandata.yml manually adds 6 mirror URLs that CI should add automatically (R39), (2) template placeholder url='' in conanfile.py (CS5), (3) missing pipefail in test.sh (CS7), (4) non-standard output markers in test.sh (CS9), (5-6) two || true without explanatory comments (CS10), (7) status inconsistency between manifest.yaml (published) and notes.md footer (built), (8) phantom patch metadata in manifest.yaml referencing non-existent patches, (9) prohibited .log file in PR (RM19), (10) platform-specific shebang (CS6, P3). Verdict: PASS.
